title: DSC 106 Lab 1: Personal Portfolio
description: Created the initial personal portfolio website to introduce my background and present my work as a UC San Diego Mathematics and Data Science student.
alt: Personal portfolio image created for DSC 106 Lab 1

title: DSC 106 Lab 2: Responsive Portfolio
description: Styled the portfolio with a responsive project grid, shared navigation, and a consistent visual design.

title: DSC 106 Lab 3: JavaScript Enhancements
description: Added JavaScript-powered navigation, a persistent color-scheme selector, and contact form behavior to the portfolio.

title: Limit Order Book Simulator
description: Built a price-time priority limit order book from LOBSTER tick data across 10 NASDAQ equities. Modeled adverse selection across 50,000+ trade events and implemented an inventory-adjusted market-making strategy.

title: TWAP/VWAP Execution Engine
description: Implemented TWAP and VWAP execution algorithms on intraday data across 30 S&P 500 equities, and evaluated their execution costs across simulated market regimes.

title: AI Investment Research Platform
description: Built an investment research platform that extracts CIO equity-market insights from institutional reports, applies NLP to quantify sentiment and sector themes, and maps market views to ETF exposures.

title: Sports Sensor Analytics
description: Engineered features from wearable sports sensor data and transformed sensor signals into structured performance metrics for sports analytics.
